description: Get the currently authenticated Calendly user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with a 'resource' key holding the current user object (uri, name, slug, email, scheduling_url, timezone, current_organization, created_at, updated_at); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List event types, optionally filtered to a single owner user.

user.description: Optional user uuid or user URI to filter event types by owner.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with 'collection' (list of event type objects) and 'pagination' (count, next_page); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single event type by its uuid.

uuid_.description: The uuid (or full URI) of the event type.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with a 'resource' key holding the event type object; on failure (event type not found), output contains an error message.

description: List scheduled events, optionally filtered by owner user and status.

user.description: Optional user uuid or user URI to filter scheduled events by owner.

status.description: Optional status to filter scheduled events by (e.g. 'active' or 'canceled').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with 'collection' (list of scheduled event objects) and 'pagination' (count, next_page); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single scheduled event by its uuid.

uuid_.description: The uuid (or full URI) of the scheduled event.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with a 'resource' key holding the scheduled event object; on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the invitees for a scheduled event.

uuid_.description: The uuid (or full URI) of the scheduled event whose invitees are listed.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with 'collection' (list of invitee objects) and 'pagination' (count, next_page); on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.

description: Book a new scheduled event for a given event type, optionally with an invitee.

event_type.description: The uuid (or full URI) of the event type to book.

start_time.description: Optional ISO start time; defaults to the current time when omitted.

end_time.description: Optional ISO end time; defaults to the current time when omitted.

location_type.description: The location type for the event (default 'zoom').

location.description: The location value for the event (default empty string).

invitee.description: Optional invitee object with keys name, email, and timezone; an invitee is created only when an email is provided.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with a 'resource' key holding the created scheduled event object; on failure (event type not found), output contains an error message.

description: Cancel a scheduled event by its uuid, cascading cancellation to its invitees.

uuid_.description: The uuid (or full URI) of the scheduled event to cancel.

reason.description: Optional cancellation reason; defaults to 'Canceled by host' when omitted.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a dict with a 'resource' key holding cancellation details (canceled_by, reason, canceler_type); on failure (event not found), output contains an error message.
